items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Lenox. [INTERVIEWEE] No, not Lenox. That's the East side. I'm talking about the West side.

ctx.x: But I was trying to think of this club... Now, this was in a club that they had up there on about 147th Street. Now, what's the name of it?
No, not Lenox. That's the East side. I'm talking about the West side. What's the name of it...? Near Edgecombe.
